images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: dwelling | tw

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a narrow two-storey gable-front frame house with two small attic windows, a hipped full-width porch on turned posts, a tight side gap to the neighbours; a man in the side yard

why.note: the 30-35 ft streetcar-era lot: the gable turns to the street so the house fits the width
